authorization: Owner requested RQ scoping, separate pipelines, evidence consolidation and sequential real analyses, then report.
exposure: All earlier Nb4 results, current A22/A13/A8 conclusions, screened literature and Murthy metadata coverage known; exploratory specification fixed before new numerical calculations.
primary_population: source normal distal lung; external normal lower/upper left lobe with donor/assay/protocol/location matching; two fibroblast subtypes only
normalization: full-gene library denominator; per-cell linear CPM for composition accounting, pseudobulk log2(CPM+1) for donor gene contrasts
inference: donor descriptive estimates and observed ranges/leave-one-donor-out diagnostics; no cell-level biological p-values, no pooled cohorts or assays
composition_reference: 50:50 captured alveolar/adventitial mixture; a defined accounting reference, not physiological tissue composition
endpoint_panel: All seven genes required. No data-driven gene selection; C3 not in the chemokine panel. Leave-one-gene-out panels are diagnostics.
murthy_labels: Previously deposited epithelial_subanalysis candidate labels; no reannotation to improve MYRF results
maturation_gate: Linked non-RNA mature contribution required for A8; unavailable in these atlas inputs, so do not fit a maturation outcome model
source_root_argument: read-only cache root; original repository used for local execution; no private context needed
sequence_dependency: Each subsequent stage verifies that the preceding immutable run_record.json exists
stop_rule: Missing count provenance, invalid cells/joins, noninteger/negative counts or altered source hashes fail the stage; missing biological endpoint remains an explicit hold while eligible reference diagnostics execute.
